mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, it is 58 degrees with overcast skies at Badger Prairie County Park. The moon is in its first quarter phase tonight. The ISS will pass overhead, but you will not be able to see it due to the clouds. Tonight's low will be 55 degrees with no rain predicted.

The city has announced that chip seal road maintenance begins on September 23. Work will occur on Cross Country Road, parts of E Verona Avenue, and the Liberty Business Park. Please use caution as lane closures will be in place. Additionally, the City Plan Commission will meet on October 5 to discuss various development projects.

There is plenty to do in Verona! Today, you can visit the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival or participate in the Bike the Barns fundraiser at Badger Prairie County Park. Live music is also happening at Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company today. Looking ahead, you can check out yoga tomorrow or trivia nights starting on Monday.
In a report covering September 10, officers responded to a burglary at Hunters Cove Way where a shot was fired; the suspect was apprehended and a handgun was recovered.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed for a scheduled remodel, so there is no flavor of the day available today.
